fullPassage: The ability to understand emotions — to have a diverse emotion vocabulary and to understand the causes and consequences of emotion — is particularly relevant in group settings. Individuals who are skilled in this domain are able to express emotions, feelings and moods accurately and thus, may facilitate clear communication between co-workers. Furthermore, they may be more likely to act in ways that accommodate their own needs as well as the needs of others (i.e. cooperate). In a group conflict situation, for example, a member with a strong ability to understand emotion will be able to express how he feels about the problem and why he feels this way. He also should be able to take the perspective of the other group members and understand why they are reacting in a certain manner. Appreciation of differences creates an arena for open communication and promotes constructive conflict resolution and improved group functioning.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

The ability to understand emotions is particularly (A)[relevant / irrelevant] in group settings. Individuals skilled in this domain can (B)[facilitate / hinder] clear communication. Appreciation of differences (C)[promotes / prevents] constructive conflict resolution.

det.korean: 감정을 이해하는 능력은 집단 상황에서 특히 (A)관련이 있다. 이 분야에 능숙한 개인들은 명확한 소통을 (B)촉진할 수 있다. 차이에 대한 인식은 건설적인 갈등 해결을 (C)촉진한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① relevant — facilitate — promotes: 본문 그대로 relevant(관련 있는), facilitate(촉진하다), promotes(촉진한다)
❌ ② relevant — hinder: hinder(방해하다)는 내용과 반대
❌ ③ irrelevant: 감정 이해는 집단에서 특히 관련 있다고 했으므로 irrelevant 불가
❌ ④ irrelevant — hinder: 둘 다 반대 의미
det.tip: relevant(관련 있는) ↔ irrelevant(관련 없는), facilitate(촉진하다) ↔ hinder(방해하다)
